name: io.github.JOSETRA44/mef-mcp
title: MEF Perú
description: Live data from Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance: daily budget execution, open data and public investment projects.

environmentVariables.name: MEF_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the response cache and the local SQLite database. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\mef-mcp on Windows and the OS cache directory elsewhere.

environmentVariables.name: MEF_DB
environmentVariables.description: Explicit path of the SQLite database used by mef_sync and mef_sql. Defaults to <MEF_HOME>/mef.db.
